preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N and 1 <= N <= 1000 and all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S has length N between 1 and 1000 inclusive, and consists only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression:
stdout.strip() == '
'.join(str(len(equivalence_classes(S))) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
postconditions.description: For each test case string S, the output is the number of distinct equivalence classes of all its non-empty substrings, where two substrings are equivalent if they have the same length and one can be transformed into the other by reversing substrings with an even number of '1's.
